Watch Aamir Khan as Krishna tease his Radha played by Gracy Singh in this exceptionally entertaining song from Lagaan sung by the great Asha Bhosale and Udit Narayan.
Song Name - Radha Kaise Na Jale
Movie - Lagaan
Singer - Asha Bhosle & Udit Narayan
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricist - Javed Akhtar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
2001 Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
